name: Just Bare Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Chunks (Costco Cult Favorite)
whyItWorks: Made from solid whole-muscle chicken breast chunks with a very light flour dusting rather than a heavy, thick batter. Bakes up crispy in a toaster oven without absorbing deep fryer grease.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake in oven or air fryer until golden. Avoid dipping into spicy sauces or heavy mayonnaise if experiencing active symptoms.
